title: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. translated_title: 二比特的N-Gram记忆：大语言模型中查找表的量化
translated_abstract: 条件记忆通过选择性查找来扩展语言模型的容量，但完整的嵌入表必须始终可用以应对每一个可能的输入。我们提出了条件程序，这是一种压缩表示方法，只需重建输入所请求的行。CP用短码和局部尺度来表示每一行，并使用一个在整个表上共享的重构程序。我们通过高斯格、范数恢复以及可独立解码的行记录来实例化这种表示。CP的两比特码相比2比特最近取整量化，将输出KL散度降低了41–63%。对三个经过训练的n-gram记忆族的分析表明，类高斯的坐标统计与行之间学习到的关系并存；在相同的存储预算下，共享格结构的表现优于我们测试的拟合码本和低秩残差变体。对于DeepSeek，该方法将表存储从203GB降至51GB，为更大的工作负载留出了空间。
tldr: 本文提出条件程序（CP）压缩表示方法，仅用两比特编码按需重构大语言模型n-gram记忆查找表中被请求的行，相比标准2比特量化将输出KL散度降低41–63%，并将DeepSeek的表存储从203GB压缩至51GB。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that uses two-bit codes to reconstruct only the requested rows of n-gram memory lookup tables in LLMs, reducing output KL divergence by 41–63% versus 2-bit round-to-nearest and shrinking DeepSeek's table storage from 203GB to 51GB.
